body.name: Bounded-fan-in promise numerical edge identification
body.construction: Encode \(G\) by binary adjacency matrices, each entry of \(\Sigma\) by a reduced signed binary numerator and positive binary denominator, and \(e\) by its endpoint indices. The promise domain contains exactly the encoded triples satisfying \(\Sigma\succ0\), \(\mathcal F_G(\Sigma)\ne\varnothing\), and \(\max_v|\operatorname{pa}_D(v)|\le d\). Within that domain, \(\mathsf{NUMEDGE}_d=\{(G,\Sigma,e):|\mathcal A_e(G,\Sigma)|=1\}\); triples outside the domain are outside the promise problem.
